pois.name: Nuutoqaq Katersugaasivik
pois.intro: Das Nuuk-Museum, auch Nuutoqaq, ist das Heimatmuseum von Nuuk.

pois.name: Hans Egedes Hus
pois.intro: Hans Egede House is located in Nuuk, Greenland. It is the oldest house in the country and was built in 1728.

pois.name: Nunatta Katersugaasivia Allagaateqarfialu
pois.intro: The Greenland National Museum is located in Nuuk, the capital of Greenland. It was one of the first museums established in Greenland, inaugurated in the mid-1960s.

pois.name: Nuuk Kunstmuseum
pois.intro: Nuuk Art Museum is a local museum in Greenland, located in Nuuk, the capital. The museum contains a notable collection of paintings, watercolors, drawings, graphics, figures in soapstone, ivory, and wood, with many items collected by the businessman Svend Junge.

pois.name: Atuagkat
pois.intro: Atuagkat Bookstore was Greenland's only bookstore, located in the capital Nuuk. Atuagkat Bookstore had a wide range of books within, among other things, fiction, biographies and memoirs, children's literature, English literature for young people, in addition to the world's largest collection of Groenlandica within the bookstore industry, including an extensive antiquarian collection of Greenlandic...

pois.name: Nuuk Center
pois.intro: Nuuk Center, also shortened NC, is a shopping mall located in Nuuk, Greenland. The mall, which is the first shopping mall in Greenland, was inaugurated on July 27, 2012.

pois.name: Ukkusissat
pois.intro: Ukkusissaq or Ukkusissat is a 772 m tall mountain in the Sermersooq municipality in southwestern Greenland, located to the southeast of Nuuk Airport, an airport in Nuuk, the capital of Greenland.

pois.name: Kalaaliaraq Marked
pois.intro: Kalaaliaraq Market is a fresh food market in Nuuk, the capital of Greenland. It is located in the Old Nuuk neighborhood, approximately 150 m to the southeast of the Nuuk Cathedral, and its name means "The little Greenlander" in Greenlandic language.

pois.name: Pikkori Sport
pois.description: Major sports goods shop in Greenland according to their fb-page. Bicycles for rent according to visitgreenland.com/destinations/nuuk/

pois.name: Brugseni
pois.intro: Brugseni or Brugsen is a Greenlandic supermarket chain, which was founded in 1991 as a union of separate cooperatives dating back to 1963.

pois.name: Nuuk Turistkontor
pois.intro: Nuuk Tourist Office is a landmark in Nuuk, Greenland, built in 1992 to house the headquarters of the new National Tourist Board of Greenland. It was built to not only provide information to tourists but as an attraction, with a fake Christmas tree and an extremely large postal box.
